Title: Azure Cosmos DB SLA 99.999 percent read availability at global scale

Body.Content: We have been making continuous improvements to our stack and are proud to announce even stronger SLAs for Azure Cosmos DB. Database accounts spanning two or more Azure regions will now have a 99.999 percent SLA for read availability. This SLA will apply regardless of the choice of consistency level. Learn more here.
